items.title: Qwen4-Max enters preview on Alibaba Token Plan and Qwen apps
items.summary: Alibaba put a preview of Qwen4-Max in its Token Plan and in Qwen apps and Qoder, pitched at coding and agent work. Developers can try it now through the plan; no benchmarks and no weights yet.

doubt.pushback: Preview only: the post gives no benchmark numbers and weights are not released (per @plotarmordev).

items.title: Claimed ~700 tok/s for Qwen 3.8 27B on one RTX 5090, no code shown yet
items.summary: A builder posted a 38 second clip claiming about 700 tokens per second decoding Qwen 3.8 27B on a single RTX 5090. The post has no repo, settings or method, and repliers are asking where to get the code.

doubt.pushback: Nothing to check: no link, repo, batch size or context length is given, and repliers ask about prefill speed and long-context drop-off without an answer.

reception.summary: Mostly excited replies and requests for other cards (4090, 3090, 5070 Ti, Spark, Metal); questions on prefill speed and 256k context went unanswered. One reply says the author's TensorFold work is strong.

items.title: HyperQwen: vLLM patches for Qwen 3.8 27B at 127 tok/s on one 24 GB RTX 3090
items.summary: An Apache-2.0 repo with vLLM patches and a requantized model pipeline that serves Qwen 3.8 27B on a single 24 GB card, with reported 127 tok/s single user at 250 W and about 1,035 tok/s aggregate at 64 concurrent requests, 150k to 262k context.

items.title: cortiq gets an experimental CUDA backend: 111.5 vs 80.2 tok/s on an A40 at 4k tokens
items.summary: A community contributor reports a new CUDA path for the cortiq runtime running the Spark-X2.6-4B file at 111.5 tok/s after 4k tokens versus 80.2 on Vulkan, and 100.7 tok/s at 64k with 8.2 GB peak VRAM. Thread notes it is tested on one A40 and has no speculative decoding.

doubt.pushback: Numbers are author-reported on one A40 and the thread itself says far context beyond 8,192 tokens is approximate and perplexity trails MLX 4-bit.

items.title: Roboflow evals put Gemini 4 Carbon first overall on vision tasks, but slow and costly
items.summary: Roboflow's vision evals rank Gemini 4 Carbon #1 overall, #1 in long text transcription (99.09%) and text localization (85.21%), #2 in object detection, #4 in JSON extraction. Cost is about $91.89 per 1,000 images at high effort and 81 s per image, the slowest of the field.

items.title: RoboDojo-RC: Gemini 4 Carbon scores 54% on Tier 1, first to 100% on three-bowl stacking
items.summary: The RoboCurve benchmark reports Gemini 4 Carbon at 54% on RoboDojo-RC Tier 1, a record among LLMs, and the first model with a 100% success rate on stacking three bowls, based on 120 published runs.

items.title: Voice Arena: ElevenLabs Scribe v3 Live tops streaming speech-to-text in Romanian and Indian English
items.summary: Voice Arena tested Scribe v3 Live on 70+ hours of real phone calls: first on all ten metric splits in Romanian (7.31% semantic WER) and Indian English (2.85%), and a statistical tie in the top four for US English and Brazilian Portuguese.

items.title: fal adds Meshy Rigging: auto-rig humanoid 3D models with finger rigs and multiple animations
items.summary: Meshy's rigging model is now on fal and turns humanoid 3D models into animation-ready characters, including fingers, with several animations per character and export for Unreal, Unity, Blender and Mixamo.
